title: KYE Compliance Mapping Rail™
description: Single-document binding of one regulatory framework's controls / obligations to the KYE Protocol™ runtime events, audit events, and evidence packs that produce evidence for them. Used by the evidence-pack exporter, the conformance reporter, and the Notified-Body / auditor / GRC audit interface.

framework.description: Canonical short name of the regulatory framework.

control_ref.description: Identifier of the obligation / control / article inside the named framework (e.g. AIA_HIGH_RISK_LOGGING, ISO27001_A_8_15, NIST_RMF_GOVERN_2_1, SOC2_CC1_5).

kye_controls.description: URNs of the KYE Protocol™ runtime / audit / signal events that produce evidence for this control.

evidence_pack.description: URN of the canonical evidence pack template the auditor receives.

kye_profiles_required.description: Profile IDs that must be active for this mapping to be valid.

policy_bundle_refs.description: Rego / Cerbos policy bundle URNs that enforce the control at runtime.
